t: You're looking at Two Piece Reclining Figure No. 5, a sculpture by Henry Moore at Kenwood House. Moore was an English artist best known for his semi-abstract, monumental bronze sculptures, which stand as public works of art around the world. He also made many drawings, including a series showing Londoners sheltering from the Blitz during the Second World War. The material I have on this piece is thin, so I'll leave it there.
